2 μF is the upper terminal capacitor by itself. The other series elements lower the equivalent further.

figure.alt: Three 2 μF capacitors share the same top and bottom rails. Terminal A connects to the top rail through a 2 μF capacitor. Terminal B connects to the bottom rail through a 3 μF capacitor.
